scientific_integrity.proof_basis: stationary empty-interval recurrence and local Markov generator

scientific_limitations: Jump rate D is known and strictly positive; all claims use the infinite integer chain.
Each reset independently draws a fresh product-Bernoulli configuration; quenched same-configuration resetting is excluded.
Only contiguous empty-block stationary statistics are proved invariant, not all spatial multipoint statistics.
The inverse theorem uses exact stationary density and the right derivative of a one-site time correlation; noisy estimation remains untreated.
The continuum static exchange is implicit in earlier forward formulas; historical priority for this complete discrete inverse classification is not independently certified.
title: Complete interval-statistic aliasing and kinetic identification in reset coagulation
